tpl: <who>{は|wa-topic}<when>できる{だけ|dake-extent}<act>ようにしています。
why: できるだけ means as much as one can, so だけ follows できる to set the limit at one's maximum.

act: 野菜[やさい]{を|o-object}食[た]べる
eat as many vegetables as possible
階段[かいだん]{を|o-object}使[つか]う
use the stairs as much as possible
drink as much water as possible
日本語[にほんご]{で|de-means}話[はな]す
speak in Japanese as much as possible
go to bed as early as possible
read as many books as possible
go home as early as possible
